data.narrative:
Ephemeris Net is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Dennis Fong and Nicolas Brown. The target has raised $3M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and a deep roster of private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Sierra Space, ICEYE, and Starcloud, though narrow peer matching at the Seed stage is constrained.

Of three valuation methods tested, only stage-progression proved applicable. Using $3M in total raised as a proxy for implied Seed valuation, a standard Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $8M. Peer-median benchmarking was not viable; while 14 same-sector private companies exist, fewer than three matched narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or comparable valuation tier), making narrow-set medians unreliable. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales could not be applied, as target revenue is not on file—standard for early-stage private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, centered at $8M, derived from a single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable Seed-stage transaction data in Space & Aerospace, lack of target revenue visibility, and the reliance on a generic stage-progression multiplier rather than sector-specific step-up calibration. Additional revenue or customer traction data would enable public-comp anchoring and strengthen the range.
